versions.changelog:
cross-border-patent-risk-screen v1.0.0

- Initial release of a cross-border e-commerce patent risk screening skill.
- Supports rapid preliminary risk assessment of design, invention, and utility model patents using product image URLs or e-commerce links.
- AI extracts design and technical features for comparison against the global patent database; provides risk level and avoidance suggestions for 174 countries within 10 minutes.
- Outputs a structured risk report with detailed patent lists, risk grades, and practical suggestions.
- Integrated automatic image processing, semantic search, and up-to-date legal status filtering for actionable results.
